name: B3 Lounge - Restaurant - Bar
kurzbeschreibung:
**B3 Lounge – Restaurant – Bar in Wattens**

Discover a stylish retreat in the heart of **Tirol**, where modern comfort meets authentic charm. **B3 Lounge** invites you to unwind in a sleek, contemporary setting just minutes from **Innsbruck**, blending urban flair with alpine serenity.

Indulge in refined dining with a twist—our menu features fresh, locally sourced ingredients, from hearty **Tiroler Gröstl** to delicate seafood dishes. Pair your meal with expertly crafted cocktails or fine wines from our curated selection.

After dinner, stay for the evening’s highlight: live music, DJ sets, or late-night drinks in our vibrant bar. Whether you’re celebrating a special occasion or simply seeking a relaxed escape, **B3 Lounge** in **Wattens** delivers an unforgettable experience.

Perfect for business meetings, romantic dinners, or a night out with friends—your perfect evening awaits in **Tirol’s** most dynamic lounge.
